summary.what_it_does: The page is a quick-start guide for the Z.AI Open Platform. It walks through four steps: register or log in, create a Standard API key and top up billing, pick a model, and choose a calling method. Listed models are GLM-5.3, described as the flagship for software engineering and agent work, and GLM-5.3-FLASH, described as a multimodal coding model for visual programming. Calling options are a standard HTTP REST API, official Python and Java SDKs, and OpenAI Python SDK compatibility. The page also shows example calls using cURL, the official Python and Java SDKs, and the OpenAI Python, Node.js and Java SDKs.
notable: OpenAI SDK compatibility for migrating existing OpenAI code
Official Python and Java SDKs with GitHub repos
GLM Coding Plan subscription compatible with 20+ agent tools
caveats: Billing requires topping up; the GLM Coding Plan is advertised from $18/month
Pricing for the API itself is not stated on this page
